hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a proprietary curve, takes input tokens from the pool manager into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, enforces a curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — fully replacing standard Uniswap v4 AMM execution.
